content: Bab-Dummad Davidʼbo igar-mesisad
David bato e-reyneggi-gudiidgine, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-Natánʼye-nugadga sogded: —Be an-dakena, andi urwar-neggi maid. Bab-Jehová-Dadganbo-Igar-Mesisad-Uludi, dordonegyaba siid.
Degi, Natán, Davidʼga sogded: —Be-binsaedba na be ibmar-imako, ar Bab-Dummad beba gudiid.
A-mutikidba, Bab-Dummad, Natánʼga sunmaknonikid. Ega sogded:
“Be nao. An-mai-Davidʼga be sognao, ‘Bab-Dummad weyob sogye: David, an-megega be anga neg sobosulid.
An Israel-dulemar Egiptoʼgi-onosad-akale, emi-ibadsega, neg-sobaledgi an megdisulid. Unnila dordoneg-sobaledginbi an gudii daed, degi, anse-goled-neg-nabir-selegedginbi an gudii daed.
Bela Israel-dulemarba an gudigusgua, deunni an Israel-e-dummaganga sogsagua, anga an-dulemar-idugoye. ¿A-dulemarga an sogsa, anga urwar-neg sobmaloye? A-dulemarse an neg-egichissulid.’
”Degisoggu, an-mai-Davidʼga be sogo, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikad weyob sogye: ‘Sapurba be sibad-wawaad-akwedga be gudigua, an be-sunonikid. An-Israel-dulemar-iduegala an be-susad.
Ar bia be naddibe, an beba gudii daed. Degine, an be-isdarmalad bega obelosbalid. Ani, an be-nug we-napneggi odummobaloed. Dulemar-nug-bur-dummarba-megismaladyobi, an be-nug odummogoed.
Deginbali, an-Israel-dulemarga deyopira amba an yar ukbaloed. Agi ambikuogu, bar ainirosurmalad. Be-isdarmalad, idualedyob ibigwensuli bar be imakosurmalad.
An an-Israel-dulemargi dule-igar-nabomalad-dummagan-onugimaksad-akale, e-isdarmalad bela anse galakunoni gusmalad. ” ’A-ukinbali, an bega sogbalid, ani, Bab-Jehová, an bega be-wagan-urbebaloed.
Be-ibagan bergudanikile, be burgwidele, be-sorbali, be-machi-gwensak rey-gangi-sigega an imakoed. E-negselegoed, an ogannogoed.
A-dule anga neg-soboed, degi, e-yar-seoed an bargindioed. Deyob, e-yar-seodi, degisadegu guoed.
An e-babga guoed, degi, e, an-machiga gumogoed. An-sabgued an egi obanosulid. Igi an-sabgued dule-be-iduar-negsesadgi an obachagusa, an deyob imakosulid.
A-dule-rey-gangi-sigoedi anse-goled-neggi, degi, an-yar-dakmaidgine, degisadegu e-yar-semaid an-bargindimai guoed. E-negseleged gandikidba-selemai degisadegu guoed.’ ”
Natán, negburgan-daksadba, we-gayaburba bela Davidʼga sogsad.
David Bab-Jehováʼse gochad
Degidgi, David, Bab-Jehováʼbo-sunmakegala, Bab-Dummad-asabin signonikid. Ega sogded: “Bab-Jehováʼye, ¿ande doasunna? ¿An-neguyade ibusunna? Emide, we-ibmar bela be anga uknagu.
A-ukinbali, Bab-Dummad, emide be anga sogbalid, be an-wagan-yoedse-danikoedgi be nued-binsabaloye. Bab-Jehová, bur bule dule-nug-nikadiyob be an-imaked.
”Bab-Dummad, ¿ibu an bega bar sogbalirgebe? Emide be, weyob angi-nued-binsanaigu. Ani, an-be-maiga-gudiid, magasar be an-daked.
Bab-Jehováʼye, be bela we-ibmar-gegerdaklemalad an-sabedba be imaksad. Degi, na be-abegedba be imaksabalid. Deginbali, be we-ibmar-magar-itogega be an-imaksabalid.
”Bab-Jehováʼye, anmar nue be-wisid, dule-baid beyobidsulid. Degi, Bab-Dummad-baid be-imbagi maisurbalid.

We-napneggi, ¿biti-dulemar-baid Israel-dulemaryobi bukwabali? Ar Israel-dulemarbi, be-dulamarga-imakegala, degi, be-nug-ogannogegala, na be sabsur-wilebukwadgi onosad. Degine, ibmar-gegerdaklemalad be imaksabalid. Deunni, be-dulamar Egipto-yargi be onosgua, be dule-bamalad barmete gusad, degi, dule-bamalad-e-bab-dummagan be barmete gusbalid.
Israel-dulemar be-dulamarga-guega na be susad. Bab-Jehová, bee be e-Bab-Dummadga gunonikid.
”Bab-Jehová, angi be sunmaksadi, degi, an-wagangi be sunmaksabalidi, mer be iegena gadin. Be-sogsadba degisadegu be imakena gadin.

Adi, be-nug mer ielegegar, degi, be-nug-degisadegu odummoledii gubaligar. Bela dulemar sogmalagar: ‘Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi, Israel-e-Bab-Dummadid.’ Deginbali, an-wagan degisadegu bese bendakledii guegar.
”Bab-Dummad, an-wagan reymarga degisadegu maiguoed-wisguega be an-imaksad. A-ulale, ani, an be-maiga-guedi, bese an ibmar egisnaid.
Emisgi, Bab-Jehová, bee, be Bab-Dummadid. Anga be ibmar-nued-ukoye be sogsad.
A-ulale, an bese wilesakwaa egisnaid, an-wagangi ise-nued be binsaoye. Adi, an-wagan degisadegu bega arbadii guegar. Bab-Jehová, an-wagangi be nued-binsassoggu, ega igar-nueganbi degisadegu naoed.”
